command: set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; adb -s "$SERIAL" get-state | grep -qx device; STATE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1 | tr -d '\r'); echo call_state=$STATE; test "$STATE" = "0"; BEFORE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell ps -A | grep -E '[[:space:]]shell[[:space:]].*shizuku_server' || true); echo shizuku_before="$BEFORE"; if [ -z "$BEFORE" ]; then adb -s "$SERIAL" shell test -f /sdcard/Android/data/moe.shizuku.privileged.api/start.sh; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell sh /sdcard/Android/data/moe.shizuku.privileged.api/start.sh; sleep 2; fi; AFTER=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell ps -A | grep -E '[[:space:]]shell[[:space:]].*shizuku_server' || true); echo shizuku_after="$AFTER"; test -n "$AFTER"; echo shizuku_server_ready=true
